title: Stations
subtitle: Manage your radio stations.
empty: No stations yet. Create your first one!
delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
card_subtitle: Fill in the details for your new radio station.
description_placeholder: A brief description of your station
mount_helper: e.g. /main or main. Used as the stream mount point on the server.
mount_helper_edit: The path after the slash — your Icecast/Shoutcast mount point.
library_empty: No songs in this station's library.
library_empty_hint: Add songs from the main library to get started.
library_dialog_empty: All songs from the main library are already in this station.
queue_empty_hint: Add songs from the station library to build your queue.
queue_delete_message: Remove {{count}} selected items from the queue?
queue_add_dialog_empty: No songs in the station library.
stream_stop_message: Are you sure you want to stop the stream? Listeners will be disconnected.
stream_restart_message: Are you sure you want to restart the stream? This will temporarily disconnect listeners.
prebuffer_helper: Max played items kept in queue (0 = unlimited). A playlist group counts as 1.
crossfade_helper: Smooth transition between songs (0 = off, max 15s).
transition_mode_helper: How the station transitions between songs. Crossfade overlaps the fade duration; Autocue uses cue points from song analysis (added songs are analyzed in the background); Off starts each song at its beginning.
autocue_fade_helper: Upper limit (seconds) for the overlap in Autocue mode, derived from the song's cue points (0 = no overlap).
auto_dj_description: When no scheduled entry is active, AutoDJ fills the queue automatically using these settings.
auto_dj_station_hint: Songs added to this station's library will be used.
auto_dj_global_hint: Every song in the system is available for selection.
auto_dj_min_gap: Min songs before same artist repeats: {{count}}
auto_dj_songs_ahead_hint: AutoDJ keeps this many upcoming songs in the queue at all times.
weighted_empty: No weighted playlists. Add playlists with weights for probability-based selection.
